field.label: Blacklist enabled
field.help: Enable automatic download of the AbuseIPDB blacklist into the pf table.

field.label: Minimum confidence score
field.help: Only IPs with at least this confidence score (25-100) are included. 90 = high-quality hits only.

field.label: Maximum number of IPs
field.help: Upper limit on IPs pulled per run. Free-tier supports 10,000.

field.label: Block on interface(s)
field.help: Comma-separated list of OPNsense interface identifiers where the block rule is active. Single identifier = per-interface rule (e.g. "wan"). Multiple comma-separated = floating rule on all listed interfaces (e.g. "wan,opt1" for multi-WAN / failover). Default: wan.
